purpose: Produce a minimal Thoughtful mouth source after two curved candidates read as waves at native 200x200. Only one compact mouth mask may be exported.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole visual reference for V9 identity, exact eyes, highlights, nose, scale, and ink weight

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the sole image input. All V42 generated art is inactive evidence and is not an image-generation input.
identity_locks: Keep the exact V9 open-eye body, one main highlight, one tiny sparkle, centered small rounded nose, brows, cheeks, face scale, and monochrome identity.
Do not redesign any component other than the Thoughtful mouth.
mouth_contract: One single compact rounded horizontal dash, mostly flat with only a tiny one-sided lift at one end. It must be complete, calm, cute, and readable as a closed thoughtful mouth at native 200x200. No center dip, no two peaks, no wave, no squiggle, no hook, no moustache, no W-mouth, no O-mouth, no frown, and no disconnected pieces.
